name: Hawk-eye No. 2
aliases: Kodak No. 2 Hawk-eye Model C 50th Anniversary
note: C0093. Verified (camera-wiki, blog.jimgrey.net, americanhistory.si.edu): the 'Kodak Brownie 50th Anniversary' seller listing is actually the No. 2 Hawk-eye, Model C, reissued in 1930 as Kodak's 50th-anniversary-of-founding (1880-1930) giveaway to children turning 12 that year (~550,000 distributed, identified by a gilded paper seal). Sellers call it 'Brownie' because it is a box-camera lookalike, not because it is one. camera-wiki keeps Model C on the same page as the plain 'Hawk-eye No. 2', so I aliased here rather than minting. Recommend adding a variants[] entry: {"name":"Model C, 50th Anniversary of Kodak edition","tell":"gilded/gold foil paper seal on camera side, single viewfinder, no aperture choice","premium":true}. Do NOT confuse with a 1950 Brownie-turns-50 edition — no such special edition was found in any source checked; the '50th Anniversary' is Kodak's own 1880-1930 founding anniversary, not the Brownie product line's.

name: Kodak Petite
